Dataset and version: JRC Tropical Moist Forest (TMF) Annual Changes, 2025 update*
Annual newly degraded and deforested areas were aggregated to a fixed 0.05°grid to identify first threshold-level disturbance events and subsequent disturbances
Primary analytical use: Event identification and classification; disturbance-history and sample-eligibility assessment; baseline forest-condition and analysis-area construction; recurrent-disturbance censoring

Coverage used in this study: 2001-2023; event window from t−3 to t5
The annual EVI matching panel was used for matching; for the primary response, quality-controlled 16-day EVI was aggregated to the 0.05° grid and then used to derive monthly matched effects and annualized responses; no pixel-level TMF forest mask was applied
Primary analytical use: Matching eligibility and covariate construction; construction of monthly EVI anomalies, matched effects, and annualized vegetation-greenness responses

Geometry validity checks; not used in analytical resampling or statistical calculations
Primary analytical use: Map background and national boundary display
